title: "Flinders middens: age distribution and saturation (oldest per midden)"
output: html_document
Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(1)

out_dir <- "C:/github/SNR_SDM/Results/age distribution and saturation/flinders"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

Load and collapse to oldest age per midden

```{r load}
fl_raw <- read_csv(
"C:/github/SNR_SDM/Data/processed/Flinders middens.csv",
show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
rename(
sample_name = Sample_Name,
age_cal_bp = 'mean age Cal BP'
) %>%
mutate(
sample_name = str_squish(as.character(sample_name)),
midden_id = str_extract(sample_name, "^\\S+"),
age_cal_bp = abs(as.numeric(age_cal_bp))
) %>%
filter(!is.na(midden_id), !is.na(age_cal_bp))

fl_midden <- fl_raw %>%
group_by(midden_id) %>%
summarise(
n_dates = n(),
oldest_bp = max(age_cal_bp),
youngest_bp = min(age_cal_bp),
.groups = "drop"
)

ages <- fl_midden$oldest_bp

list(
n_rows = nrow(fl_raw),
n_middens = nrow(fl_midden)
)

fl_midden %>% arrange(desc(oldest_bp)) %>% print(n = min(12, nrow(fl_midden)))
```

Core plots

```{r hist_kde}
p_hist_kde <-
ggplot(fl_midden, aes(x = oldest_bp)) +
geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 12, alpha = 0.5) +
geom_density(linewidth = 0.8) +
labs(
x = "Oldest dated age per midden (Cal BP; abs)",
y = "Density"
) +
  theme(
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey90"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "grey90")
  )


p_hist_kde
ggsave(
file.path(out_dir, "hist_kde_oldest_age.png"),
p_hist_kde,
width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300
)
```

Bootstrap uncertainty + learning curves

```{r bootstrap_learning}
bootstrap_stat <- function(x, stat_fn, B = 5000) {
replicate(B, stat_fn(sample(x, size = length(x), replace = TRUE)))
}

learning_curve <- function(x, stat_fn, n_min = 3, B = 2000) {
x <- x[is.finite(x)]
map_dfr(n_min:length(x), function(n) {
sims <- replicate(B, stat_fn(sample(x, size = n, replace = TRUE)))
tibble(
n = n,
est = mean(sims),
lo = quantile(sims, 0.025),
hi = quantile(sims, 0.975)
)
})
}

boot_median <- bootstrap_stat(ages, median, B = 5000)
boot_max <- bootstrap_stat(ages, max, B = 5000)

median_ci <- quantile(boot_median, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
max_ci <- quantile(boot_max, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))

ci_tbl <- tibble(
statistic = c("median(oldest_bp)", "max(oldest_bp)"),
lo = c(median_ci[[1]], max_ci[[1]]),
mid = c(median_ci[[2]], max_ci[[2]]),
hi = c(median_ci[[3]], max_ci[[3]])
)

ci_tbl
write_csv(ci_tbl, file.path(out_dir, "bootstrap_CIs.csv"))

lc_all <- bind_rows(
learning_curve(ages, median, n_min = 3, B = 2000) %>% mutate(stat = "Median"),
learning_curve(ages, max, n_min = 3, B = 2000) %>% mutate(stat = "Max")
)

p_lc <-
ggplot(lc_all, aes(x = n, y = est)) +
geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.2) +
geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
facet_wrap(~stat, scales = "free_y") +
labs(
x = "Number of dated middens",
y = "Bootstrap mean estimate (95% interval)"
) +
theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

p_lc
ggsave(
file.path(out_dir, "learning_curves_median_max.png"),
p_lc,
width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300
)

write_csv(lc_all, file.path(out_dir, "learning_curves_data.csv"))

```

```{r}
# --- Text-only statistical summary -------------------------------------------

ages <- fl_midden$oldest_bp
n_middens <- length(ages)

cat("\nFLINDERS MIDDENS – TEXT SUMMARY\n")
cat("--------------------------------\n")
cat("Number of middens:", n_middens, "\n\n")

cat("Oldest dated age per midden (Cal BP, absolute):\n")
cat("  Minimum:", min(ages), "\n")
cat("  Maximum:", max(ages), "\n")
cat("  Median :", median(ages), "\n")
cat("  IQR    :", IQR(ages), "\n\n")

# --- Bootstrap uncertainty ---------------------------------------------------

set.seed(1)

B <- 5000
boot_median <- replicate(B, median(sample(ages, replace = TRUE)))
boot_max    <- replicate(B, max(sample(ages, replace = TRUE)))

median_ci <- quantile(boot_median, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
max_ci    <- quantile(boot_max,    c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))

cat("Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals:\n")
cat("  Median oldest age:\n")
cat("    2.5% :", round(median_ci[1]), "\n")
cat("    50%  :", round(median_ci[2]), "\n")
cat("    97.5%:", round(median_ci[3]), "\n\n")

cat("  Maximum oldest age:\n")
cat("    2.5% :", round(max_ci[1]), "\n")
cat("    50%  :", round(max_ci[2]), "\n")
cat("    97.5%:", round(max_ci[3]), "\n\n")

# --- Saturation / stability check -------------------------------------------

tolerance_bp <- 2000  # change if you want (e.g. 1000 or 3000)
step <- 5

set.seed(2)

learning <- lapply(3:n_middens, function(n) {
  sims <- replicate(2000, median(sample(ages, size = n, replace = TRUE)))
  c(
    n = n,
    est = mean(sims),
    lo  = quantile(sims, 0.025),
    hi  = quantile(sims, 0.975)
  )
})

learning <- do.call(rbind, learning)
learning <- as.data.frame(learning)

learning$delta <- abs(learning$est - dplyr::lead(learning$est, step))

stable_n <- learning$n[learning$delta < tolerance_bp][1]

cat("Stability assessment (median oldest age):\n")
cat("  Tolerance:", tolerance_bp, "years\n")
cat("  Step size:", step, "additional middens\n")

if (!is.na(stable_n)) {
  cat("  Median estimate stabilises by ~", stable_n,
      "middens (changes <", tolerance_bp, "years thereafter)\n")
} else {
  cat("  Median estimate does NOT stabilise within tolerance across available middens\n")
}
```
